title: Sentry Alpha-09
description: Corrupted flight logs reveal Arc ship life support was intentionally flooded with toxic warp drive exhaust.
exit_prompt: Beyond the gate a passage climbs back to the surface. Leave the dungeon?

title: Dredge Overseer
description: An infected overseer confesses L.E.O. is an industrial harvester extracting Shards from the dying.

title: Abyssal Sentinel
description: Decoded naval comms confirm underwater refineries in the Sunken Mere and a strict quarantine to trap survivors.

title: Doc Razorclaw
description: Datapad reveals cybernetics were banned because synthetic nerves are immune to plague and useless for mana.

title: Corrupted Arch-Druid Malakor
description: Memory residue exposes imperial councilors intentionally poisoning pristine planetary roots with Arc drive sludge.

title: The Weeping Matron
description: A vision shows the Captain's grandfather tried to scuttle his Arc ship to prevent continental slaughter.

title: Automated Gatekeeper Goliath-V
description: Maintenance logs show regional colonies form nodes in a transmutation circle targeting 2,000,000 deaths.

title: Inquisitor Kraven
description: Kraven reveals the Smilodon elite left Kat-Prime to slumber in orbit until the Leviathan Cube finishes distilling.

title: Azurian Core-Minder
description: Psychic resonance reveals the peaceful native rock-hive was enslaved to chisel the world-folding Leviathan Cube.

title: High Inquisitor Vane
description: Empress hologram reveals the Captain was baited as a biological cypher to unlock the final transmutation vault.
